# Maxxi — USB-C PD Eurorack Power Supply: Full Schematic Design Review

**Project:** Maxxi (KiCad 10, single sheet, generated by `tools/gen_schematic.py`) — **no PCB** (`Maxxi.kicad_pcb` is a 79-byte placeholder)
**Date:** 2026-09-23 · **Schematic snapshot:** mtime 2026-09-22 23:07 (rev 1, 2026-09-22) · **Analyzer run:** `analysis/2026-09-22_2351/`
**Analyzers run:** `analyze_schematic.py` (modern format, full signal analysis) · `diff_analysis.py` vs `analysis/2026-09-22_2217` · `deep_review_gate.py` (17 findings verified, 0 quarantined)
**Authoritative intent source:** `tools/gen_schematic.py` pin maps (the schematic is machine-generated; all fixes belong in the generator, then regenerate).

## Overview

USB-C Power Delivery sink PSU for a Eurorack system: J1 (Type-C 16P) → F1 (3 A/24 V PTC) → D1 (SMBJ20A) → **+VBUS**; U1 CH224K negotiates a fixed **20 V** contract (CFG1 left NC). Three TPS54360B stages: U2 buck → **+12V6** (12.565 V), U3 inverting buck-boost → **−12V6** (chip GND rides on −12V6), U4 buck → **+5V** (5.078 V). LDO post-regulators: U5 LT1963AEQ → **+12V**, U6 LT3015EDD (negative LDO) → **−12V**. Outputs: J2/J3 16-pin shrouded Eurorack headers (mirrored Doepfer convention), J4 2-pos terminal block (+5V aux). Rail LEDs D5/D6/D7.

Both were one-line fixes in the generator.

## Critical Findings (review state 2026-09-23 morning, pre-fix)

| # | Severity | Issue | Evidence basis | Fix |
|---|----------|-------|----------------|-----|
| B1 | **CRITICAL** | **U3 −12V6 feedback divider shorted.** R40.1 and R41.2 both land on net −12V6 — which is also U3's GND/GNDPAD net. FB2 sits at 0 V vs the chip's 0.8 V reference forever → error amp rails, duty runs to max, **−12V6 is unregulated** (current-limit bound). The generator's own comment “FB divider for U3 senses GND->-12V6: fix R net for that topology” sits above a no-op stub — the fix was never written. | Raw-file + generator + analyzer agree (3 sources); topology per TPS54360B datasheet Fig. 50 (p34) | In `gen_schematic.py` buck() for the U3 stage: R40 pin 1 → `GND` (not `pos_out_net('2')`). Then −0.8·(1+10k/680R) = **−12.565 V** — exactly symmetric with U2. |
| B2 | **CRITICAL** | **U5 +12 V divider values swapped.** R50 10.2k is OUT→ADJ (top), R51 90.9k ADJ→GND (bottom). LT1963A holds ADJ at 1.21 V to GND ⇒ Vout = 1.21·(1+10.2/90.9) ≈ **+1.35 V**. The generator's own description computes 11.99 V — with the opposite arrangement. | LT1963A datasheet p14 formula + p13 “The ADJ pin voltage is 1.21V referenced to ground”; wiring from generator + analyzer + raw | Swap values: **90.9k top / 10.2k bottom** → 12.02 V (incl. I_ADJ term). Note: a previous planning pass called this "correct as-wired" by inverting the formula — datasheet grounding settles it: swapped. |

Both fixes are single-net/value changes in `tools/gen_schematic.py`; regenerate the schematic afterwards and re-run ERC.

## Power Tree

```
USB-C VBUS_RAW ──F1 3A/24V PTC──D1 SMBJ20A──+ +VBUS (20 V PD contract, CH224K CFG1 NC)
                                              ├─R2 1k→ VDD (CH224K internal 3.3 V LDO, C3 1µF)
                                              ├─U2 TPS54360B buck ──L1── +12V6 (12.565 V = 0.8·(1+10k/680R))
                                              │     └─U5 LT1963A LDO → +12V  (setpoint BUG: +1.35 V as-wired)
                                              ├─U3 TPS54360B IBB ──L2── −12V6 (−12.565 V intended; BUG: FB divider shorted)
                                              │     └─U6 LT3015 LDO(neg) → −12V (−11.79 V w/ datasheet Vref −1.22)
                                              └─U4 TPS54360B buck ──L3── +5V (5.078 V = 0.8·(1+10k/1.87k))
                                                                                    ├─ J4 terminal, J2/J3 pins 5/6
U2/U3/U4 FB refs: TPS54360B 0.8 V (datasheet p5, "lookup"-class) · U5 ref 1.21 V (LT1963A p13) · U6 ref −1.22 V (LT3015 p14)
```

fsw = 484.7 kHz from RT = 200k (TPS54360B Eq. 8; datasheet table row: 450/500/550 kHz). IBB switching stress: V_SW(pk) = 32.57 V vs chip GND (60 V class ✓), IL(pk) = 3.2 A vs 4 A inductor sat and 4.5 A min current limit.

## Deep Review (per-IC usage vs datasheet)

All 17 findings in `analysis/deep_review.json` passed the gate (0 quarantined). Highlights with inline evidence:

**U1 CH224K — clean, matches reference schematic on all five networks.** Datasheet page 4 rendered and inspected visually: Fig 6.1 (CH224K) shows **CC1/CC2 direct to the chip** — the 5.1 kΩ pulldowns on that page belong to the CH224D companion figure; Rd is integrated, no external CC parts needed (analyzer UC-003 = false positive). VDD network 1k+1µF = Fig 6.1; DP/DM tied with 1k pulldown = Fig 6.3 PD-only mode (“short-circuit DP and DM on CH224K/CH224D side”, p3); PG 10k→VBUS = Fig 6.1; CFG1 NC → 20 V (strap table p4; §5.2.2: “and 20V may be requested at this time”). VDD abs max 3.6 V is internal-regulator-clamped per the intended network (§7.5, 0–30 mA sink).

**U2/U4 TPS54360B — correct usage; comp inherited from TI 5 V example.** RT = 200k → 500 kHz class ✓ (p5 table). EN dividers: 20 V × 22/(100+22) = 3.61 V — above 1.2 V threshold, far below 8.4 V abs max ✓. BOOT 100 nF = recommended ✓ (p12). Comp R33/R39 13k + 6.8 nF + 39 pF are verbatim TI 5 V/600 kHz example values (p28–29) — at 12.57 V the crossover is ~2.5× lower; benign for a pre-reg, re-run Eq. 44–51 if transient response matters (info).

**U3 TPS54360B in IBB — chip-referencing correct, feedback broken (B1).** GND/EP, RT, COMP, EN-bottom on −12V6 matches datasheet Fig. 50 chip-grounding exactly. Catch diode orientation (cathode→SW, anode→−12V6) correct; SS56 60 V vs 32.57 V reverse stress ✓ (~1.8×).

**U5 LT1963A — SHDN/enable correct, divider swapped (B2), dropout marginal (H6).** SHDN→IN is mandatory-for-unused (p13: “If unused, the SHDN pin must be connected to VIN”); abs max ±20 V ✓. Output caps: 47 µF ceramic + 100 nF OK (min 10 µF, ceramic-stable, p14).

**U6 LT3015 — negative LDO confirmed; SHDN/EP/Vref findings above (H3) + EP note:** exposed pad is IN and must be soldered to the **−12V6** island in layout (p2) — unusual convention, layout-phase trap. Output cap 47 µF ceramic OK (≥10 µF, ESR ≤500 mΩ, p16). Current limit 1.7–2.3 A with foldback beyond 8 V IN-to-OUT — not active at 0.565 V headroom ✓.

**Rails/setpoints (rails.py):** +12V6 12.565 V · +5V 5.078 V · +12V 1.35 V (BUG → 12.02 V after fix) · −12V6 unregulated (BUG → −12.565 V after fix) · −12V −11.79 V (H3). LED currents 4.4–4.5 mA (fine). Cap deratings: C1/C2 57 %, C50/C51/C53/C54 50 %, C56 20 % ✓; C37 93 % ✗ (H1).

## Power Analysis

- **Budget (power_budget.py):** rated loads (+12/1.5 A, −12/1.5 A, +5/3 A) → P_out ≈ 51 W, P_in ≈ 61 W (η: buck 0.90, IBB 0.84, 5 V buck 0.86, LDOs pass-through) → **3.04 A @ 20 V vs F1 3.0 A hold** (H4). 60 W adapters insufficient at the rails' rated limits; 100 W-class needed.
- **Inrush:** ~240 µF bulk to 20 V = 0.05 J; PTC 1812L300/24 Imax 40 A, cold resistance + cable limit the peak — acceptable.
- **Sequencing:** all three bucks enable together from +VBUS via 100k/22k dividers; LDOs follow their pre-rails. No inter-rail sequencing required for this architecture (LDO inputs ramp with bucks; soft-start internal). PG unused (info finding).
- **Derating:** see rails.py table above; C37 the only failure.
- **Sleep current:** mains-powered context (PD adapter) — not battery-relevant; Eco-mode pulse-skipping at light load noted (raises ripple, p12 — acceptable for Eurorack audio).

## Thermal Analysis (estimates — no PCB exists)

thermals.py, 40 °C ambient, bottom-up switch-loss models: U2 Tj ≈ 55 °C · U3 ≈ 73 °C (+ D3 diode 0.85 W, H5) · U4 ≈ 66 °C · U5 ≈ 64 °C · U6 ≈ 77 °C. All within ratings (TPS54360B 150 °C; LT1963A/LT3015 125 °C) **given the datasheet-recommended PowerPAD/EP via arrays and copper** — the generator's SOIC-8 footprint already specifies thermal vias; the DFN EP must land on the −12V6 island (see Deep Review). These are estimates, not measurements; re-check after layout.

## False Positives / Reviewer Overrides

| Analyzer finding | Disposition |
|------------------|-------------|
| PP-001 errors: U3.7/9, U6.1/2/9 “no DC path to a power rail” on −12V6 | **False positive.** −12V6 is a legitimate rail (U3 IBB output via L2/D3, bulk C34/C35). The rail-source audit doesn't model IBB chip-GND referencing. |
| UC-003 CC1/CC2 missing 5.1k pulldowns | **False positive.** CH224K integrates Rd; datasheet Fig 6.1 shows direct CC hookup (5.1k belongs to CH224D figure). |
| UC-001/UC-002 no decoupling/TVS at J1 VBUS | **By design.** C1/C2 (200 µF) and D1 sit after F1; TVS-after-fuse is intentional (fuse clears hard TVS events). Residual: no cap on VBUS_RAW segment itself — acceptable. |
| VD-004 “over-designed” 35 V caps on +VBUS | Analyzer assumed +VBUS = 5 V (no PD awareness). Real working point 20 V → 57 % derating: correct choice, not over-design. |
| FS-001 U2 divider impedance 637 R | Fine: 1.18 mA divider current, within TI guidance (bottom < 800 kΩ). |
| VD-001 C50 “marginal” 12.6 V on 25 V | 2:1 margin — passes project derating; dismissed. |
| Analyzer U5 est 0.667 V / U6 est −0.669 V / +12V rail 0.667 V | Heuristic artifacts. Superseded by computations: real as-wired +12 V = 1.35 V (B2), −12 V = −11.79 V (H3). |
| “Regulator U3/U6 missing capacitors” detection artifact | U3 has C37 input + C34/C35 comp + C36 BOOT; U6 has C53/C54/C55. Pattern matcher missed the IBB/negative topology. |
| Rail "+12V = 0.667 V" in rail_voltages | Downstream of the same U5 heuristic + the analyzer's −12V parse failure; raw + computed numbers above are authoritative. |

## Post-review correction (2026-09-27): B7 — L2 inductor output on wrong net (CRITICAL, fixed)

The rail-membership spot-check above ("−12V6 (U3 via **L2**/D3/… ✓") was wrong, and the B1 fix pass
missed a second consequence of the same generator pattern. Per TI SLYT286 (*Using a buck converter in
an inverting buck-boost topology*): relative to a normal buck, **"the inductor and catch diode have
switched places"** — the catch diode goes SW→−12V6 (D3 was correct) and the **inductor goes SW→system
GND** (SLVA317B Eq. 4, D = −VO/(VI−VO), holds only with this arrangement; TPS54360B d/s §8.3.1 Fig. 50).

As generated, **L2.2 landed on −12V6** (same net as the IC's own GND pin), leaving L2 and D3 in
parallel between SW and the rail with no path that ever pulls charge out of the −12V6 node — the
−12V6 rail would collapse toward 0 V and the −12 V output cannot regulate.

Fixes applied 2026-09-27:
- `Maxxi.kicad_sch`: the global label at L2's output (264.16, 124.46) renamed `-12V6` → `GND`.
- `tools/gen_schematic.py`: `buck()` gained `l_out_net=None` (inductor output override, mirrors
  `fb_top_net`); U3 call passes `l_out_net='GND'`.

Verified: KiCad netlist now `L2.2 = GND`, `D3 = SW2/−12V6` unchanged, U3 pins 7/9 still on −12V6;
netlist vs. the pre-fix schematic differs only by L2.2 (−12V6 → GND); ERC 0 errors / 0 warnings.
Setpoint unchanged: −12.565 V. If regenerating from the generator, the manual layout edits are
overwritten — re-apply layout separately.
